blockers.title: Test OCR shares the regular app's Tesseract language cache
blockers.evidence: src/capabilities/studentScan.ts:1264 creates the Tesseract worker without cachePath or cacheMethod. node_modules/tesseract.js/src/worker-script/index.js:112,181,274 reads, writes and deletes `${cachePath || '.'}/ita.traineddata`. Its browser/cache.js adapter uses idb-keyval, whose default store is IndexedDB keyval-store/keyval. Both channels therefore use './ita.traineddata'. The scratch probe reproduced cross-channel reading and deletion in Chromium and WebKit: the test path read the regular path's synthetic bytes, deleted the key, and the regular path then read undefined.
blockers.reproduction: Run node test-results/security-review-r1/shared-ocr-cache.mjs. It serves the installed idb-keyval module on one synthetic origin, opens /CVC_helper/ and /CVC_helper_test/ in one browser context, writes the regular channel's default Tesseract key, reads and deletes that key from the test path, and asserts its absence from the regular path. Both engines reproduced the collision. Give the test worker a distinct cachePath while preserving the regular cache namespace; verify actual OCR initialization creates separate keys.
blockers.specRef: 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md D3 §4, permanent test site: database, preferences, workers and caches must be separate; explicit owner instruction requires separate browser storage on the same GitHub Pages origin.
